description: This file contains utility functions for caching thumbnails and screenshots of charts and dashboards in the Superset project, utilizing Celery tasks for asynchronous processing.

methods.name: cache_chart_thumbnail
methods.description: Asynchronous task to cache a thumbnail for a specific chart, using chart ID and user context.

methods.name: cache_dashboard_thumbnail
methods.description: Asynchronous task to cache a thumbnail for a specific dashboard, using dashboard ID and user context.

methods.name: cache_dashboard_screenshot
methods.description: Asynchronous task to cache a screenshot of a dashboard, supporting guest tokens and various cache options.
